scope.objective: Test one deterministic, at-most-once multi-flip cell update after the frozen 59-path returns a strictly negative selected-cell margin.
scope.expansion_condition: Run the other five public-sat ACT-UNKNOWN cases only after at least one initial-tier positive candidate passes the unchanged terminal.

frozen_rule.name: flip_all_tight_strictly_negative_marginal_phase_rows_once
frozen_rule.base_model: The frozen 59-path selected exact-phase affine LP: minimize negative selected-rival margin, HiGHS dual simplex, presolve disabled, primal feasibility tolerance 1e-9.
frozen_rule.marginal_sign_semantics: For minimization of negative margin with A_ub x <= b, a strictly negative upper-bound marginal says a local RHS relaxation decreases the minimized objective and therefore locally increases margin.
frozen_rule.set_rule: Select every eligible row simultaneously. There is no marginal-magnitude threshold, top-k, tie, threshold scan, or subset search.
frozen_rule.deterministic_order: Map screened rows back through the frozen keep mask, then rebuild changes in topological layer order and ascending exact-row local position. Selection is a set; order only fixes triangular-delta serialization.
frozen_rule.update: Negate each selected phase Boolean, rebuild exactly one candidate affine cell from the same first stream using the existing triangular phase-delta representation, and solve exactly one more LP for the same selected property row.
frozen_rule.commit_rule: The updated candidate margin must be strictly greater than the first LP margin. Infeasibility, no eligible row, non-improvement, malformed marginal, numerical failure, or deadline stops with UNKNOWN.
frozen_rule.positive_rule: Only a strictly positive updated candidate is decoded and sent through the unchanged raw BOX, verifier-owned zero-width interval forward, and stored-binary64 Fraction property lower bound.
frozen_rule.interpretation: The LP marginal chooses a candidate phase set only; it neither proves a bound nor authorizes a verdict.

restrictions.terminal_authority: raw BOX plus verifier-owned zero-width interval forward plus exact stored-binary64 Fraction property lower bound

results.audit_reproduction: Selection count and digest, base margin, updated margin, and terminal Fraction lower bound reproduced exactly without changing the rule.

results.reason: The frozen LP produced no primal/marginal from which the single update rule could select a set.
The frozen LP produced no primal/marginal from which the single update rule could select a set.

phase_consistency_audit.finding: The updated candidate LP factors are not a strict replay of the selected float phase assignment. Tiny143 has 22 sign discrepancies and a maximum sign violation about 2.36e-8, which exceeds the configured unscaled 1e-9 tolerance.
phase_consistency_audit.safe_interpretation: Do not call the updated float object an exact or replay-consistent cell and do not grant its margin authority.
phase_consistency_audit.why_tiny143_verdict_survives: The terminal starts from the decoded stored-binary64 input, checks raw BOX membership, recomputes the whole network with verifier-owned zero-width forward intervals, and evaluates the property with Fraction arithmetic. It does not consume the LP phase assignment, LP cell constraints, marginal values, or candidate margin.

performance.reason_frozen_timing_invalid: sys.settrace was used only to capture frozen function locals and materially perturbs Python timing.
performance.observed_shape: The one update adds about 0.386 to 1.466 seconds before any positive terminal; Tiny143 then adds about 1.087 seconds for the unchanged terminal.
performance.current_path_ratchet: If the >=1.5x/2x rule is applied request-for-request against the current 59-path on a negative instance, this additive ability route fails by construction because it performs all current work and then more work.
performance.positive_iid2_bypass_warning: The existing positive iid2 gate would not execute the update and therefore cannot measure this ability overhead.
performance.required_future_measurement: Any integration must preregister uncontended and four-concurrent negative-path latency/memory gates, while retaining iid2 as a regression control.

decision.reason: The route produces one independently terminal-verified new counterexample, but its benchmark-wide yield is only +1/400, the candidate phase object is not strictly replay-consistent, and the additive negative-path cost has not passed a policy-valid performance gate.
decision.stop_loss: Do not try top-k variants, marginal thresholds, subset menus, a second phase update, property retries, or repeat-for-luck. The single frozen rule has completed its bounded capability census.
reopen_for_production_only_if: The performance-reference policy permits ability latency against a fixed baseline rather than requiring an additive route to beat the current 59-path request-for-request.
A no-trace implementation reuses current locals and preserves the unchanged terminal boundary.
Tiny143 and the negative control pass preregistered single and four-concurrent latency/memory gates.
Hostile fail-closed, deterministic selection, fixed-set retention, fixed400, and independent audits all pass.
